name: SDN PNM Publication History Flow
description: Gateway PNM history flow (mount GET /api/v1/peers/{peerId}/pnm): foundation/http-route discover decides the request as an $APR (pnm_history + peerId + limit); hostcap/p2p-discovery pnm_history reads p2p.pnm_history (typed $PIV, capability p2p_read; the host attributes each notice to its publisher by Ed25519 signature) and answers a $PNV beside the $APR (STATUS 404 no-publications when none are recorded); foundation/http-respond respond renders the $HTR. foundation/discovery-shape is retired. Typed contracts 1.0: every edge carries one SDS FlatBuffers type; no JSON travels between nodes (JSON exists only as the client representation http-respond renders on request).

triggers.description: One $HTQ HttpRequest envelope per invocation, pumped by the host at the flow ingress.

api.tagDescription: Peer and standards discovery served by the G.2/G.3 gateway flows (wasm; routing, format selection, limit clamping and ETag logic run inside the module; materials come from the policy-mediated p2p_read capability).

routes.summary: The peer's newest signed PNM publications (verifiable provenance)
routes.description: The peer's stored signed publication notices, newest first (?limit clamped to [1,100], default 1), each attributed to its PUBLISHER by signature verification on the host (SDS Publication Verification). Representation: FlatBuffers by default (?format=flatbuffer or Accept: application/x-flatbuffers); ?format=json or Accept: application/json renders the same record as JSON with the standard's IDL field names (enums by name, byte vectors hex) - rendered by foundation/http-respond, the only place JSON exists. Conditional GET: the record's ETAG (a content tag, stable across calls while the content is unchanged) rides the etag header; If-None-Match equal to it answers 304.

params.name: peerId
params.description: libp2p peer ID of the PUBLISHING peer (e.g. 16Uiu2HAm…).

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of newest publications to return. Default 1 (the newest). Clamped in-wasm to [1, 100].

params.name: format
params.description: Response encoding: flatbuffer = aligned size-prefixed $PNM FlatBuffer stream (default, signature-verifiable verbatim frames), json = bare JSON array of publication records.

200.description: One $PNV. Representation: FlatBuffers by default (?format=flatbuffer or Accept: application/x-flatbuffers); ?format=json or Accept: application/json renders the same record as JSON with the standard's IDL field names (enums by name, byte vectors hex) - rendered by foundation/http-respond, the only place JSON exists.

schema.description: $PNV (SDS PNV.fbs): The peer's stored signed publication notices, newest first (?limit clamped to [1,100], default 1), each attributed to its PUBLISHER by signature verification on the host (SDS Publication Verification).

304.description: Not modified: If-None-Match equals the record's ETAG.

404.description: No route, or no signed publications recorded for the peer (no-publications).

schema.description: $APR (SDS APR.fbs): the refusal record (STATUS / ERROR_CODE / ERROR_MESSAGE)
